name: dsh-build-hermeticity-proof
description: Offline proof that recorded build accesses stayed inside a declared input and output closure

interface.shortDescription: Verify a declared build access closure.
interface.longDescription: Checks hash-only access receipts for undeclared files, environment, network, clock, randomness and outputs without running or sandboxing a build.
interface.defaultPrompt: Verify this explicit build-hermeticity manifest and return only hash-based evidence.
